records.text: An unidentified embedded commentator characterized Candace Owens as a Russian state guest who made RT appearances and said the CIA had lied about Russia.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep YeEtS7nix3o)

appearances.snippet: If you don't understand what is going on here when Candace goes to Russia and is a guest of the state at this economic forum, is attending these different TV hits with RT, and she's talking about how surprised she is that it's a beautiful country and that the CIA must have lied to her all of these years about what Russia is like. If you fall for this, you are the mark for this kind of. ... of propaganda.

verification.notes: Owens appeared on RT during SPIEF and publicly praised Russia while criticizing Western portrayals. Research did not establish the stronger claim that she was a formal Russian state guest, and the paraphrase about the CIA is looser than the available sourced wording.

sources.title: Candace Owens Makes Pitch for Tucker Carlson on Russian State TV
sources.relevance: Confirms Owens appeared on RT during SPIEF.

sources.title: Candace Owens in Moscow: discovery of Russia and criticism of the Western narrative
sources.relevance: Primary broadcaster account of Owens’s RT interview and criticism of Western depictions.
